name: easyeda-pro-control
description: Safety-gated EasyEDA adapters, narrow symbol/PCB workflows and seven engineering skills.

interface.longDescription: Seven skills cover EasyEDA Pro control, schematic design, PCB layout, component libraries, manufacturing release, design review and extension development. Version-pinned typed API adapters distinguish supported public subsets, native equivalents, blocked implementations and documented omissions. Discovery and schemas do not grant execution support. The legacy batch writer remains runtime-disabled. Dispatcher ded07x99dcxb504 is connected-read-admitted only on its reviewed tuple; future mismatches fail closed. Current readers cover calculations, editor/project metadata, PCB layers, loaded identities and bounded geometry; raw model fields are not necessarily rendered geometry or saved contents. Writing remains narrow: eligible unused project-local symbol metadata and schematic-container titles, with separate disposable symbol-copy and PCB-title workflows. Each write requires its own runtime, original ownership, complete closed-database effect checks and fresh saved readback. General schematic/PCB geometry, referenced-symbol propagation and library writers remain unfinished. The native diagnostic workflow retains the original Windows process and Job, admits exact source/context identities and exposes fixed worker and model observations without arbitrary debugger code. Four non-atomic samples cover compiler state, pending producers, bounded raw Strings and selected model, tool and secondary-index state. They do not prove empty-board or whole-board completeness, queue completion or writer eligibility. Installed120717 retained an event-callback refusal with event kind unknown while project opening was pending; completed opening was not established. Original normal closure, process/Job termination and terminal helper release passed, and the closed disposable fixture remained unchanged. Source-derived root-fragment and PCB-child event-policy corrections now preserve exact frame, loader and context boundaries while accounting for separate browser and renderer notifications. They have no connected qualification yet. Two pure String models compose first-fixture exclusions and supplied create/raw-model/publication evidence; all ownership, complete-effect, Save and writer authority remains false. Bounded first-failure diagnostics name request/event refusal categories without exposing payloads or retroactively identifying older unknown events. Project/PCB/model observations still require connected qualification. Startup and opening use the existing profile and may restore tabs, migrate data, replay caches or automatically Save. They are not isolated or guaranteed unchanged. Ambiguous calls remain consumed; inspection, normal closure, proved process/Job termination and helper release are separate steps. Lost ownership cannot be reconstructed from journals. No implicit Save/Discard, forced termination, blind retries, arbitrary caller JavaScript or unrestricted Save is supported. Missing installation files select offline-only startup. A dependency-free offline catalog checker uses a separate synthetic profile, not the live owner. Consult the packaged skills, exact operation contracts and per-method coverage inventory for supported subsets, evidence and remaining work.
defaultPrompt: Validate the EasyEDA bridge without bypassing compatibility gates.
Inspect the admitted EasyEDA project with exact readers and managed evidence.
Apply the requested typed design change and verify it after saving and reopening.
